categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Build system' label and touches Guix build scripts and CI workflow files (`contrib/guix/libexec/*`, `.github/workflows/guix.yml`).
categories.rationale: Adds `-D_GLIBCXX_USE_DEPRECATED=0` to Guix host compiler flags to turn off deprecated libstdc++ interfaces and slightly reduce debug symbol overhead. It is a minor compiler configuration tweak with no urgent impact on release integrity or build reliability.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Guix scripts under `contrib/guix` are build and release infrastructure, which the category explicitly excludes in favor of the build category.
categories.rationale: Excluded because release and Guix build tooling belong under build rather than tools.
